board.title: Board
board.intro: Seven young structural engineers who run YouCon alongside their work. They organise the excursions and theme evenings and are your first point of contact.
board.groupPhotoAlt: Group photo of the YouCon board

bios.tom: Tom is a BIM structural engineer at BUCC and calls himself a modern structural engineer. He sees construction as a complex puzzle, both technical and non-technical. He is committed to automation, knowledge sharing and simplification, and likes to show what AI can do for structural engineering.
bios.lise: Lise is a structural engineer at IMd Raadgevende Ingenieurs and studied at TU Delft. As secretary she manages the membership records and the mailbox, and makes sure agreements and minutes are written down.
bios.femke: Femke is a structural engineer at Witteveen+Bos and graduated on reusing cast-in-place concrete in new construction. Sustainability and the reuse of materials run through her work. She combines new techniques with traditional knowledge, because physics remains the basis of every structure.
bios.janPeter: Jan-Peter is a bridge engineer at Arup, where he has worked for ten years. He enjoys telling students what it is like to be a structural engineer, for example at the meet & greet at the Dag van de Constructeur.
bios.coen: Coen is a structural engineer at Haskoning and studied at TU Delft.
bios.paul: Paul is a structural engineer at Pieters, growing into a project leader role. With a master's in Building Engineering from TU Delft and an MBA, he combines engineering with management. One of his major projects is De Waaren: the redevelopment of the former V&D building in Leiden, a listed monument that is becoming a place to work, shop and stay.
bios.florine: Florine is a structural engineer at Movares.

privacy.title: Privacy statement
privacy.intro: What personal data YouCon processes through this website, why, and what your rights are.

sections.title: Who we are
text: YouCon is the study association for young structural engineers. YouCon is responsible for processing the personal data collected through this website.

sections.title: What data we process
text: When you create or use an account, we store:
list: the company you work at, if you fill it in;
your password, stored encrypted. We can't see it;
the activities you sign up for.

sections.title: Signing in with Google
text: If you sign in with your Google account, Google gives us your name, email address and profile picture. We use your name and email address for your account. We don't use your profile picture. We don't give Google any information about what you do on this website.

sections.title: What we use your data for
text: We only use your data to:
list: manage your account and let you sign in;
keep track of your registrations for site visits and theme evenings, so we know who is coming and whether there are places left;
check with your date of birth whether you are within YouCon's age limit (up to 35);
contact you about activities you have signed up for.

sections.title: Legal basis
text: We process your data because it is needed for your account and your registrations: you ask us to when you create an account or sign up (performance of a contract).

sections.title: Who can see your data
text: Only the YouCon board and web admin can see accounts and registrations. Other members can't see your data. We don't sell your data or share it for marketing.

sections.title: Parties that help us
text: We use services from others for the website. They only process data on our behalf:
list: Supabase: database and sign-in. The data is stored on servers in Frankfurt (Germany);
Google: only if you choose to sign in with Google.

sections.title: How long we keep data
text: We keep your data as long as your account exists. Want your account deleted? Email info@youcon.nu and we'll delete your account and registrations.

sections.title: Cookies
text: We only use cookies that are needed to keep you signed in. We don't use cookies to track you or to measure visits.

sections.title: Your rights
text: You may view, correct or delete your data. You may also object to its use or request a copy to take elsewhere. You can change your name, company and date of birth yourself on your account page. For anything else, email info@youcon.nu.
Not happy with how we handle your data? You can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

sections.title: Changes
text: We may update this privacy statement, for example when the website changes. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
